text: Idaho Legislature INTERNSHIP APPLICATION INFORMATION 2018 Session Who May Apply Legislative internships are unpaid positions. Internships are open to undergraduate and graduate students. All students seeking to be placed as interns must be approved by their institution and must have a faculty sponsor who will oversee the student’s internship. Arrangements for academic credit must be made directly between students and their institutions. Availability Internships will be served during the 2018 Legislative Session at the State Capitol in Boise. The session will begin on Monday, January 8, 2018, and is expected to conclude in March or April. Applicants should indicate their preferred work days and times on the application. Attachments Applicants must submit a one-page personal statement, their most recent transcript, and a current résumé with their application. The personal statement should detail the applicant’s qualifications and interest in a legislative internship. The résumé must include three references. Applicants who fail to submit all required materials will not be considered for an internship. Interview Appointment to an internship may be dependent on a personal interview. Applicants may be asked to sit for an interview with members of the Legislature prior to being appointed as interns. Orientation All interns must attend a half-day orientation early in the legislative session. Additional information about orientation, including the date, time, and agenda, is forthcoming. Submission Information Students seeking an internship must submit their application materials by Friday, November 17, 2017. Questions may be directed to Terri Kondeff, Legislative Services Office, at 208.334.4828 or tkondeff@lso.idaho.gov.
